decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach with left arm toward the mallet handle; lift and gradually orient the open gripper.
Move above the handle in the left workspace while rotating toward a downward grasp aligned with the shaft.
Complete shaft-aligned downward orientation and approach the handle near its free end, staying open for visual alignment.
Make a small wrist-view centering correction, descend to the shaft, and close the left gripper.
Finish closing, then lift vertically to check mallet retention in RGB.
Lift the retained mallet clear and move its head toward the leftmost red key, preserving shaft orientation and closed grip.
Align the mallet head with the leftmost red key, then begin a controlled vertical approach; depth remains visually uncertain.
Lower the mallet vertically onto the leftmost red key while retaining the handle.
Lift clear of the red key by 5.5 cm, then shift one key right to the orange key without lowering.
Strike the second, orange key and lift the mallet more than 2.5 cm before proceeding right.
Move the lifted mallet one key right, then strike the third, yellow key while keeping the left hand closed.
Lift from the yellow key by 5.6 cm, then translate to the fourth, green key with the mallet clear.
Strike the fourth, green key vertically, then lift the mallet 6 cm clear before moving farther right.
Translate above the fifth, light-blue key and lower the mallet for the next strike, preserving left-to-right order.
Lift from the light-blue key by 5.6 cm and shift to the sixth, dark-blue key, keeping the handle securely closed.
Center the mallet over the dark-blue sixth key during descent, strike, and lift 6 cm before the next key.
Correct the rejected tensor; move to the seventh purple key above the keys, then strike vertically. No prior motion occurred.
Lift 5.6 cm clear of the seventh key and move above the final magenta key, without crossing the arms.
Replan after continuity rejection with smaller increments, slightly nearer the robot and lower while staying above the final key.
Strike the final magenta key, then lift vertically by more than 4 cm, maintaining the closed grasp.
